intro: Write and review bilingual articles, guides, and neighborhood pages.
slug_hint: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. The slug is fixed after creation.
note_hint: Visible to administrators in revision history.
publish_requirement: Complete both translations and add a public source before reviewing.

review.title: Review revision
review.details: Mark saved revision {{revision}} as reviewed and ready to publish.

publish.title: Publish revision
publish.details: Publish the English and Spanish versions of revision {{revision}} on the public site.

unpublish.title: Unpublish
unpublish.details: Remove both translations from the public guides. The draft and revision history are available in this editor.

restore.title: Restore revision
restore.details: Copy revision {{revision}} into a new draft. It will need review before publication.
restore.done: Revision copied to a new draft.

errors.access: Editorial content is unavailable for this session.
errors.missing: This editorial entry is no longer available.
errors.conflict: This entry changed while you were editing. Reload the current revision before making another change.
errors.slug_taken: This slug is already in use. Choose a different one.
errors.validation: Check the length and format of your fields, including the source links.
errors.sources: Enter a label and a valid public HTTPS URL for each source.
errors.uncertain: The result could not be confirmed. Check the current revision before trying again.
